semantic_sketch_json.normalized_claim: For every admissible pair d,r and every admissible n, the difference between the finite sum and [r n]_q times q to the power r times (1 minus n) divided by 2 is divisible by [n]_q times Phi_n(q) squared.
quantifier_order: q is treated as a formal variable in the q-notation definitions
for all positive integers d and r with gcd(d,r) equal to 1 and r less than or equal to d
for every integer n greater than 1 such that n is congruent to 1 modulo 2d
k is the summation index running from 0 to n minus 1

statement_nl: Let [m]_q = (1−q^m)/(1−q), let (a;q)_k = ∏_{j=0}^{k−1} (1−aq^j), let (a,b,c;q)_k = (a;q)_k (b;q)_k (c;q)_k, and let Φ_n(q) be the nth cyclotomic polynomial. Prove that for positive integers d and r with gcd(d,r)=1 and r ≤ d, and for every integer n > 1 with n ≡ 1 mod 2d, we have Σ_{k=0}^{n−1} [3dk+r]_q (q^r,q^r,q^d;q^{2d})_k (q^d;q^d)_k^2 q^(k(d−dk−2r)/2) / (q^{2d};q^{2d})_k ≡ [rn]_q q^(r(1−n)/2) mod [n]_q Φ_n(q)^2.
